films.title: 房屋是黑色的（暂译）
films.aliases: The House Is Black；La Maison est noire
films.topic: 患者日常、疾病与社会隔离、诗歌
films.method: 诗性旁白、观察、声画对照
films.form: 纪录短片
films.summary: 记录伊朗巴巴巴吉麻风病患者社区的日常生活，将诗性声音与人物、身体和活动并置。
films.teaching:
高校影视传媒教学建议（依据公开资料核验，未逐片完整观看）：建议用于诗歌与纪录影像关系讨论，强调患者的主体性。含疾病造成的身体外观与医疗处境，教师应预览并避免污名化语言；医疗信息另用现行资料。
教学提示：含疾病造成的身体外观与医疗处境；避免污名化患者，医疗信息只作历史材料并另配现行资料。
films.courses: 诗意纪录片；伊朗电影史；纪录片伦理
films.knowledge: 诗歌旁白；患者表述；观看距离
films.discussion: 诗性表达如何帮助观众理解患者生活，又可能带来怎样的审美化风险？
films.selectionBasis: UCLA Film & Television Archive的修复展映说明其对伊朗新浪潮的影响；BFI和Cinéma du réel均有作品记录。 年份口径：采用BFI、UCLA及Cinéma du réel的1962年；瑞士电影资料馆2014节目册记1963，保留机构编目差异。 片名说明：中文为暂译；原名采用影节官方拉丁转写Khaneh siah ast，未自行拼写波斯文。

films.selectionBasis:

films.title: 法德加尔村（暂译）
films.topic: 口述传统、村庄生活、土地关系
films.method: 民族志、口述历史、生活记录
films.form: 纪录长片
films.summary: 在塞内加尔村庄中，将学校教育、长者讲述、劳动和土地关系并置，呈现社区传递历史的方式。
films.teaching:
高校影视传媒教学建议（依据公开资料核验，未逐片完整观看）：建议比较课堂书面历史和树下口述传统的叙述位置；讨论作者与故乡的关系，避免把村庄当成不变的文化样本。
教学提示：村庄肖像须结合作者位置与文化背景；避免将其作为固定不变的群体样本。
films.courses: 影像人类学；非洲电影；口述史
films.knowledge: 口述与书写；社区记忆；内部视角
films.discussion: 谁有权讲述一个村庄的历史，影片怎样容纳不同的讲述方式？
films.selectionBasis: 戛纳1979 Un Certain Regard，2018 Cannes Classics修复重映；MoMA策展强调Faye的故事传统与村庄肖像。 年份口径：原年度戛纳档案及2018修复页均明确作品1979年。 片名说明：中文名为本次暂译，正式中文发行名待核；外文名称依据所列机构或发行方作品页。

films.title: 兰屿观点
films.topic: 民族文化、医疗、观光、环境、媒介伦理
films.method: 反身性民族志、访谈、多视角结构
films.form: 民族志纪录电影
films.summary: 围绕旅游摄影、医疗与核废料争议，通过不同参与者的叙述考察达悟族生活与外来制度接触中的矛盾和调整。
films.teaching:
资料型教学建议，未逐片完整观片。
教学建议（待教师看片复核）：建议比较人类学者、医生及当地行动者的视角，重点讨论谁有权拍摄和解释；补充相关历史，避免将单一时期意见概括为族群共识。
教学提示：高校教学资料建议，未逐片观片。涉及被拍摄者拒拍、医疗观念和公共议题；应尊重拒绝被拍摄的权利，呈现不同主体立场，不将影片中的医疗信念当作医学建议。
films.courses: 影视人类学；纪录片伦理；环境传播
films.knowledge: 反身性；多声部；拍摄权力
films.discussion: 让被摄者评论摄影者本身，会怎样改变民族志电影的权力关系？
films.selectionBasis: TaiwanDocs记1993金马奖最佳纪录片，及1994法国让·鲁什民族志影展、2001台湾国际民族志影展入选；具备明确专业节展依据。 年份口径：采用TaiwanDocs及TIDF作者年表的1993。 制作国口径：TaiwanDocs列制作地区台湾，监制单位中央研究院民族学研究所。 片名说明：中文原名见TaiwanDocs；英文名见TIDF胡台丽作品年表。

films.title: Innocent（原名，中文名待核）
films.director: Gek Li San, Ho Choon Hiong
films.topic: 家庭、亲缘与迁徙（编目建议）
films.method: 自我书写（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: At the funeral, one of the directors discovers that her aunt’s death was a suicide. Together, the directors visit the site of her death—a cold concrete building—with the aunt’s husband and children as if to investigate the circumstances of her death. Reviving memories of the spaces that she once lived in through film, the directors points their camera in different directions as if seeking for something beyond the realities of the suicide. Family members and friends, convinced that they know the truth behind her death, are contrasted with those directly affected who maintain their silence. A sense of stagnation in Singapore emerges from cracks in the facts and in the testimonies of relatives as this film propels personal documentary into new directions.

films.summary: Two men diligently unload equipment and materials from a truck, put pipes together, and build a stage for a puppet theater. No matter how few people are in the audience, the show starts and ends as it always has. films.title: Last House Standing（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）

films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Mr. Jiang is a Shanghai dandy, living by himself in a house that stood the test of time since the 1930s as a witness to what happened to the city. Now, the house is about to be torn down as part of a redevelopment plan. A woman becomes a tenant and fiercely pursues the taciturn man, until he opens his mouth unraveling his unique philosophy and personal history. Combined with the verbal sparring between the two and the scenes around the house, the sadness that oozes from Mr. Jiang’s life at the mercy of Chinese history—Shanghai during the war, the fury of the Cultural Revolution, and now the present—casts a subtle shadow over the film.

films.title: Fort of the Fabrications（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 乡土、劳动与生态（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: This film is a bold attempt to conceptualize contemporary media society and the urban images at its core, applying video media as a tool to read and unravel them. Images of the mass media landscape are shown in chapters, using various symbolic aspects of media, audio and video noise as well as principles of the video medium spoken in different languages. Their accumulation creates a fabrication. While staying clear of the inanity of being a loudmouth as a proper ‘response’, this zestful film is a head-on plea for the possibility of art-in-practice through images.

films.summary: Ghada was born and raised in a Gaza refugee camp. The Japanese director met her in a Palestine under siege and continued to film her for twelve years. She marries and starts a family, but then we see Ghada as she decides to live an emancipated life as an Arab woman, and later begins to collect and record stories about her homeland and songs by elderly Palestinian women. Underscoring Ghada’s way of life is Director Furui’s own career: In a world where journalists tend to cover only tragedies, she chooses to document the richness of women’s everyday lives.

films.title: The Ants（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: A secret pact between Chinese and Japanese military commanders after the end of World War II led to 2600 Japanese troops’ being forced to remain in China to continue fighting in the civil conflict. Once back in Japan after enduring long years in POW camps, the survivors were considered deserters by the government and treated with disregard. One of the former soldiers, 80-year-old Okumura Waichi, tenaciously pressures the government to acknowledge responsibility for this unprecedented act of “selling” soldiers. A hugely popular film that broke theater records.

films.title: 修道院：维格先生与修女（暂译）
films.originalTitle: The Monastery – Mr. Vig and the Nun
films.aliases: The Monastery - Mr. Vig & the Nun；The Monastery – Mr. Vig & the Nun
films.topic: 晚年生活、宗教、共同生活
films.method: 人物观察
films.form: 纪录长片
films.summary: 年迈的Mr. Vig希望把自己购置的城堡变成修道院。俄罗斯东正教修女到来后，个人愿景与共同生活的实际需求发生碰撞。
films.teaching:
教学建议：用于分析人物目标、性格冲突与幽默的形成，讨论拍摄者怎样处理年长人物的尊严。涉及宗教生活，应补充语境，不将个案代表整个群体。 本条建议依据公开机构资料，未经逐片完整观片；具体片段请教师预览后选用。
教学提示：涉及年长者、宗教生活与人际冲突；保护人物尊严，避免将个案概括为宗教群体特征。

films.knowledge: 人物目标；情节转折；关系叙事；观察距离
films.discussion: 同一空间中不同人物的愿望，怎样构成纪录片的叙事动力？

films.summary: Unable to return even once to her hometown in Syria since leaving in 1981, Hala begins shooting a film in France with her younger friend Ammar serving as cameraman. She conducts intimate interviews with friends who remain separated from their homeland as old age approaches, and includes scenes showing the creative process of her painter husband, exiled for twenty-five years now. The camera, with its frequent hand-held shots and extreme close-ups that seem to reject an objective perspective, glides freely through time and space, revealing the poetry and urge to create poetry in daily life while lamenting the relentless passage of time and giving voice to love for one’s homeland.

films.title: Lick Salt—A Grandson’s Tale（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）

films.summary: Grandmother Cecile is estranged from director Ryan Feldman’s father, who has barred all contact between the two of them. Ryan begins forming a relationship with his grandmother after encountering her for the first time in fifteen years at his grandfather’s funeral. He witnesses the charming spontaneity of an elderly Jewish woman, as well as her fear and uncertainty toward death and her senility-induced delusions, involving talking to photographs and preparing meals for those pictured. Ryan’s anxiety about the future comes to the fore as he repeatedly switches jobs and moves house, all the while up to his neck in trying to cope with his extraordinary grandmother.

films.summary: Vig purchased Hesbjerg Castle fifty years ago, aiming to turn it into a monastery. His wishes are fulfilled when the Russian Orthodox Church officially decides to convert the Danish castle into a church and convent. The charismatic Russian nun Sister Amvrosija and others arrive for preparations, and it seems his dream is going to be realized without a hitch . . . But this elderly bachelor, who has gone without falling in love for his eighty-two years, finds himself repeatedly coming into conflict with Sister Amvrosija and her different cultural background and values. The film embraces Vig with tenderness and humor as he gradually opens up, however clumsily.

films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Middle-aged men and women singing revolutionary songs. Who exactly are these people, singing shamelessly at schools, libraries, supermarkets, and in the streets at night? Numerous music groups were created in the late 1960s, inspired by a socialist movement that burned with idealism. Some forty years have gone by, and those once young and beautiful activists have reached middle age. This Finnish musical documentary shows them as they sang exultantly back then and the way they sing at their current workplaces, nostalgically and satirically of an era that strove toward a better world.

films.summary: The Palestinian-Israeli actor Mohammad Bakri stands before the grave of Palestinian writer and politician Emil Habibi, a close friend who influenced his own work, and speaks about the things that have come to pass in his life. Bakri struggled bitterly as his two nephews were persecuted for their involvement in a terrorist incident and the screening of his documentary Jenin Jenin was prohibited in Israel. While reflecting on the words of Habibi, Bakri calls for both Israel and Palestine to face each other and come to grips with their own foolishness.

films.title: Bare（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 家庭、亲缘与迁徙（编目建议）
films.method: 档案/历史材料（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: The director is criticized by her mother and sister, who are estranged from their father over his alcoholism. With her mother and sister pulling her back and forth, she is driven to the phone by old memories of her father and his current reality. Home videos from twenty-some years ago show her father speaking tenderly to the two close sisters while they innocently play. The footage makes the viewer feel as though the joyous family videos may reveal something if one looks hard enough. The director faces her father through the phone and tries to understand him, as if attempting to bring back the past.

films.title: The Drown Sea（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 乡土、劳动与生态（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: The brackish-water region of Segara Anakan Lagoon is transforming into dry land due to silting occurring ever more rapidly since the 1980s. This is beginning to affect the lives of the Kampung Laut people, who have been running fisheries and have “lived on the sea, above the fishes” for generations. “New” residents move to the expanding dry land and forests to cultivate the earth, amid the arrival of massive cement mining boats and debates regarding the pros and cons of deforestation. The fishermen consider the fact that they can no longer make a living from fishing, as they maneuver their way around the new trees that are sprouting and overtaking the water. Their opinions intertwine above the “drowning” sea as if it is a puzzle to be solved, as each tries to accept the changing land and scenery.

films.summary: A father who has worked as a collaborator for Israel for years is forced to leave Palestine and takes his wife and five children to live in Tel Aviv. films.summary: A street corner in Lisbon. Women sit on a bench in a stone-paved square at the top of a hill. Youths mess around with motorbikes. People walk up and down the hill. Languid, listless light and wind. A tram. Children having fun playing soccer. The sound of a guitar, overlapping with the long shadows of trees. These may be ordinary everyday scenes, but they are also beautiful and somehow melancholy. This is a visual poem dedicated to a “lost city,” made over a period of 15 years by Jon Jost.

films.summary: In 2005, actress Hayashi Yumika passed away before her time at the age of 34. This is a love story in which the director pours out his heart about his romantic attachment to her. He recalls his travels with her on a bicycle trip from Tokyo to Hokkaido’s Rebun Island to film Yumika (1997), relives the moment he realized she was dead, and experiences the years since in which he couldn't make films. The teetering battle between the director, who attempts to control the film, and Yumika, who confronts him with her raw emotions, constantly shakes the film’s equilibrium. Our relationship with actress Hayashi Yumika is eternal . . .

films.title: Distinguished Flying Cross（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）
films.method: 档案/历史材料（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: A man in the twilight of his years who served in a helicopter division in the Vietnam War spiritedly recounts his experiences. Listening to his recollections are his two adult sons, sitting on either side of him. His war stories, told humorously as reckless shenanigans, gradually draw out an uneasiness in the viewer as they unfold within novelistic chapters and a frame composition reminiscent of religious painting. As the film intersperses color footage shot by soldiers on the battlefield and lively pop music that might have been heard at the time, a growing dissonance with the man’s tales reverberates throughout this cinematic adventure. Appearing in the film are the director, his father, and younger brother.

films.title: World without Shadow（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 艺术、媒介与自我反思（编目建议）
films.method: 观察式（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: In the Malaysian state of Kelantan, tossed about by politics, the shadow-play art known as Wayang Kulit marks a steady decline. Though it had coexisted with Islam since the 13th century, it has been repressed in recent years, and the number of shows is decreasing. The director carefully follows shadow puppeteers and the musicians who taste the hardship of life in the space between politics and art, who take on second jobs while continuing to perform shadow plays. Both in a performance piece satirizing the situation and in the story of the shadow play (which merges into the film itself), puppets play important roles.

films.title: The Shepherd’s Story / Shinjuku 2009 + Ogaki 2010（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 艺术、媒介与自我反思（编目建议）

films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Inoue Shinta is a flat-surface artist who has been working on “Project Shepherd” in and out of Japan since 1998. He’s a shepherd who wanders through cities that are defined by the words of taxi drivers and barbershop owners; pushing around his cart, tending to faceless and grazing 2-D sheep, one of which becomes lost and overhears various people talking about where they would like to live. While the film goes in search of a subtle form of communication, the scenery of Shinjuku and Ogaki takes shape according to a perfectly matched score created by the directors.

films.method: 口述历史、返乡旅程
films.form: 历史纪录长片
films.summary: 跟随雾社事件相关族人的后代返回祖居地，追索迁徙、失落与代际记忆。

films.knowledge: 地景记忆；代际传递；历史叙述视角
films.discussion: 回到祖居地怎样改变讲述历史的方式，镜头应如何呈现不同代际的经验？

films.topic: 艺术、媒介与自我反思（编目建议）

films.summary: A continuation of The Sound of the Waves , which screened in the “Cinema with Us” program at YIDFF 2011. Like its preceding work, this film is comprised of conversations between survivors of the March 2011 earthquake and tsunami, as well as interviews where the directors appear on screen. The voices of conversing survivors are recorded together with the voices of those lost in the waves. By layering these conversations, words begin to touch the survivor’s souls, at times overcoming their experiences of the disaster to meditate on the universals of everyday life. Their mourning for all they lost is intermixed with their hope for recovery, in a film that breaks open new borders.

films.summary: A daughter struggles to make a film. A mother criticizes this daughter for exposing her and the family. Yet, the daughter harbors something inside that is beyond a simple desire to incite anger. Her mother experienced the “Iron Age,” throwing herself into democratic struggles in a time when authorities raged with incredible violence. She still carries scars that have not healed. The director retraces her own memories of a childhood spent in absence of her activist mother, who was imprisoned after the Gwangju Massacre. As mother and daughter crystallize their various memories in fragments of words, a portrait of the mother and her time emerges.

films.summary: Eleven members of a traditional theatre troupe perform daily and live out their lives in a small playhouse in the Sichuan region of China. Their three-hour show combines various forms, from classical Chinese opera to acrobatics, and is adored by the locals. Their star actress Dandan has performed in the troupe with her mother since she was little, sharing a living space with a group of performers who share no absence of fights. Though she worries about her future, she continues to earnestly perform the heroine for her elderly audience.

films.summary: “I’ve got a talent for suicide.” The director makes a promise with his musician friend to succeed in making a teen movie. But before they can wrap production, the friend commits suicide. In his will, he wrote that he wanted the director to finish the film. Left behind, the director returns to the images they recorded, reuniting the film’s staff and actors and playing the role of his friend himself to complete a film that combines documentary and fiction. This story complicates the natural and the performed, existence and absence, moving toward its own destruction.

films.topic: 战争、冲突与历史记忆（编目建议）

films.summary: Takae, Okinawa. As residents resist the construction of helipads that threaten to encircle their village, they are indicted by their government for obstruction. We come to know the shocking truth that during the Vietnam War, Takae villagers were forced to participate in U.S. guerilla warfare training exercises as proxies for Vietnamese villagers. In their struggle against the deployment of the Osprey helicopter, Okinawans completely blockaded the Futenma base. Nevertheless, the aircraft was deployed as planned. Produced by Ryuku Asahi Broadcasting, this film is a direct statement of the Okinawan people’s sadness and fury before the American and Japanese states.

films.summary: Just a 3-minute walk from Shinagawa Station in Tokyo, there is one of Japan’s largest slaughterhouses. films.summary: In Kaizuka City, Osaka, the family-run Kitade butcher shop makes its living by raising and slaughtering cattle, selling the meat. From the moment of tension when the hammer drops on the forehead of the cow, cattle are transformed into meat through practiced movements. This labor, traditionally the work of the Burakumin, the outcastes of feudal Japan, is passed down to the next generation by parents, who hope their children will not encounter discrimination as they have. People live by eating the lives of others. This is a record of a family who looks into the nature of life, every single day.

films.summary: Production and sale of Fujichrome RT200 sound film stock ended in 1999. The product had a magnetic strip on both sides, allowing audio to be simultaneously recorded from a microphone connected to the camera. It was the ultimate analog technology. Using only this stock, the director begins to shoot a film. As he develops his long outdated and expired RT200, unique visuals and sounds begin to emerge, creating images that are persuasive, yet full of despair.

films.summary: The storytellers of Tome, Kurihara, and Tono in the Tohoku region of Japan have passed down their tales for generations. They now share their stories with Ono Kazuko, of the Miyagi Folktales Association. These folktales were born from the unforgivingly difficult life in Tohoku, and the tightly knit families that inhabit the region. This work is not only a record of folktales, but also the trust that born from the bond between storyteller and listener and the act of passing on a story.

films.title: Millets Back Home（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 乡土、劳动与生态（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: In a remote ethnic Tayal village nestled in the mountains of Taichung, an old woman is still growing millet. A man who collects trash also raises fruit trees. His son has graduated from middle school but in order to proceed to high school he moves to live alone in the city. One middle-aged woman who works in an adult day-care center was formerly unable to speak the Tayal language but she eagerly absorbs as much of it as she can. Focusing on three families, this film is both a vivid portrayal of the villagers’ way of life as they try to preserve their disappearing traditions, and a testament to the director’s respect for her village, and her people.

films.title: My No-Mercy Home（原名，中文名待核）
films.topic: 家庭、亲缘与迁徙（编目建议）
films.method: 纪录观察（待观片复核建议）
films.form: 纪录片（类型边界待观片复核）
films.summary: Dolphin, who approached the director with her story, was sexually abused by her father when she was in middle school. Opposition from her mother and relatives trying to protect her father makes her almost give up, but Dolphin takes legal action against him despite her family’s resistance. Her aim is not only to protect the two younger sisters still living with their family, but in particular to reclaim her own sense of self. She somehow continues her studies, supporting herself financially. With the help of the director and a support group for victims of sexual abuse, Dolphin takes the witness stand.

films.knowledge: 自反性；作者位置；素材重组；观察与介入

films.title: 圣餐（暂译）
films.topic: 家庭、照护、儿童成长、宗教仪式
films.method: 观察式
films.form: 纪录长片
films.summary: 14岁的Ola照顾有自闭症的弟弟和酗酒的父亲。弟弟准备初领圣餐时，她希望借这一家庭聚会使离家的母亲重新回到家中。
films.teaching:
教学建议：分析家庭仪式怎样组织人物期待和叙事进展；讨论未成年照护者的主体性、亲密拍摄的边界及避免将自闭症人物工具化的呈现方式。涉及酗酒与家庭压力。 本条建议依据公开机构资料，未经逐片完整观片；具体片段请教师预览后选用。
教学提示：涉及酗酒、未成年照护者及家庭压力；避免污名化自闭症，不把弟弟简化为推动主角成长的工具。
films.courses: 纪录片创作；人物纪录；影像伦理

films.region: 东亚 · 欧洲 · 北美
films.topic: 文化传统、成长、性别、人与动物
films.method: 人物跟拍、训练与竞赛叙事

教学提示：涉及捕鹰和狩猎；先预览，补充文化背景，不将单一个体故事视为全部女性猎鹰史。

films.title: 追寻光（暂译）
films.method: 创作过程观察、对话、视觉随笔
films.form: 纪录长片
films.summary: 影片把物理学家与艺术家对光的研究并置，跟随他们的实验、创作和交流，探索光怎样被感知、测量并转化为图像。
films.teaching:
教学建议：用于比较科学解释与艺术表达，分析镜头如何将抽象现象变成感官经验；科学知识应结合课程材料核对，勿把艺术隐喻等同于物理结论。 本条建议依据公开机构资料，未经逐片完整观片；具体片段请教师预览后选用。
教学提示：科学与艺术并置属于创作方式；物理知识另配授课材料，不将视觉隐喻等同于实验结论。
films.courses: 科学传播；影视摄影；艺术概论；纪录片创作
films.knowledge: 科学可视化；光与成像；跨学科叙事；作者视角
films.discussion: 物理实验与艺术作品对光提出的问题有何不同？电影如何让两种方法展开对话？
films.selectionBasis: DOK Leipzig 2024开幕片及世界首映；兼具科学与艺术创作过程的策展候选。 年份口径：采用German Documentaries作品年2024，与DOK Leipzig 2024开幕世界首映记录一致；不采用后续院线发行年。 片名说明：中文片名为本库暂译，尚未核实正式中文发行或影展译名；原名／国际通行名据机构资料。

films.title: 夜曲：飞蛾之夜（暂译）
films.topic: 生态；科学研究；昆虫；声音
films.method: 野外观察；环境声
